scenario.title: Failsafe on heartbeat loss, across the timeout boundary -- timeout = 1000ms, expected fault
scenario.description:
Silence the vehicle controller for a range of durations either side of the declared timeout. Short of the window the pack must keep driving; once the window has elapsed it must announce HEARTBEAT_LOST and open the contactor.
Generated from pattern 'node-silent' by harness/expand.py.
This variant places timeout at 1000ms, which is part of the spread around the boundary of timeout = 300ms under a non-strict comparison.
The expected outcome for this variant is fault.
